lines.text: Mistral Large 4 weights live: 1.1T MoE / 52B active; AA Index 26 (high)
Amazon: AWS +39% to $46B (fastest in ~5 yrs); Bedrock F500 spend ~7x YoY
Amazon AI spend: FCF outflow $42.4B TTM; 2026 cash capex guide still ~$220B

feed.headline: Mistral releases open weights for Large 4 (Le Chonk)
feed.why: 1.1T MoE, 52B active, 1M context, multimodal in / text out. Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license (MIT-like; MaaS needs a separate commercial license).

feed.headline: AA: Mistral Large 4 (high) scores 26 on Intelligence Index v5
feed.why: Independent. Trails DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3 (both 32). AA Terminal-Bench 25% and FrontierCode 15% vs Mistral’s claimed 41% and 19.7%.

feed.headline: Amazon: AWS sales +39% YoY to $46.0B; $184B annualized run rate
feed.why: Fastest AWS growth in nearly five years per the IR release. Jassy projects AWS growth over 40% in 2027 and 2028.

feed.headline: Amazon Bedrock: Fortune 500 spend nearly 7x YoY; tokens nearly 17x
feed.why: Official IR. Also Bedrock Managed Agents public preview (OpenAI-powered) and open-sourced Strands harness (32% token claim is lab).

feed.headline: Amazon: TTM free cash flow outflow $42.4B; 2026 cash capex still ~$220B
feed.why: PPE purchases drove the swing; Amazon says the increase primarily reflects AI investments. Capex guide unchanged in the same release.

feed.headline: Call: Amazon to sell Trainium AI chips outside AWS starting late 2027
feed.why: From a third-party earnings transcript, not Amazon’s IR page. Also reported: AWS backlog $578B; Q3 cash capex about $75.9B.

feed.headline: Google shutting down Jules coding agent; folds into Antigravity
feed.why: Sessions usable until 11 Nov, then read-only; winds down 31 Dec. Export tool available. Learnings move into Antigravity.

feed.headline: DeepSeek Search/Fetch free harness window ends Sat (noon ET)
feed.why: Docs: Harness/Claude Code/Codex server-side tool calls bill from 00:00 Beijing 1 Nov (= noon ET 31 Oct). $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests.

feed.headline: Moonshot: Kimi K3.1 Pro weights still due by 4 Nov
feed.why: Weights still outstanding. HF still shows Kimi-K3 only as of this morning. Site stub live.

feed.headline: Next week: Apple Mon 2 Nov; AMD Tue 3 Nov after the close
feed.why: Apple call 5:00 PM ET. CoreWeave reports Tue 10 Nov. Jules goes read-only Wed 11 Nov.
